title: Relative clauses (2)
summary: Поясняющие придаточные в деталях: **which** ко всему предложению, **most of whom / all of which**, **what**-клаузы и **whoever / whatever / whichever**.
ru:
## Which относится ко всему предложению
Обычно **which** заменяет существительное. Но в поясняющем придаточном (после запятой) оно может ссылаться на **всю предыдущую мысль** — и переводится как «что», «а это».
> She passed the exam at the first attempt, **which** surprised everyone. — Она сдала экзамен с первого раза, чем удивила всех.
> The train was cancelled, **which** meant we missed the interview. — Поезд отменили, а это значило, что мы пропустили собеседование.
- ~~She passed, that surprised everyone.~~ → She passed, **which** surprised everyone.
- ~~..., what surprised everyone~~ → **..., which** surprised everyone

Часто встречаются связки **which is why** («поэтому») и **which means** («то есть, а значит»): *The shop was closed, which is why we left empty-handed.*

## Количество + of whom / of which
Чтобы выделить часть группы, добавляем после запятой **количественное слово + of + whom (люди) / which (вещи)**: *some of whom, most of which, both of whom, neither of which, all of which, none of whom, several of whom, two of which*. Это характерно для письменной речи, отчётов и описаний.
> The company employs 500 people, **most of whom** work in the factory. — Компания нанимает 500 человек, большинство из которых работают на заводе.
> She wrote six novels, **two of which** became films. — Она написала шесть романов, два из которых экранизировали.
> He offered me two jobs, **neither of which** I wanted. — Он предложил мне две работы, ни одна из которых мне не подходила.
- ~~most of who~~ → most of **whom**
- ~~some of them whom~~ → some of **whom** (дублировать них нельзя)

## whom в поясняющих придаточных
В книжной речи для людей-дополнений поясняющее придаточное использует **whom**: *Tom, **whom** I've known for years, has moved to Berlin.* В разговорной речи допустим **who**. После предлога — только **whom** (подробнее в юните 58).

## what как «то, что»
**What** — не определительное местоимение: оно не стоит после существительного, а само содержит «то, что». Придаточное с **what** выступает в предложении как существительное.
> **What** surprised me was her calm reaction. — Меня удивила её спокойная реакция.
> I did **what** I could. — Я сделал то, что мог.
- ~~Everything what she said~~ → Everything **that** she said
- ~~The book what I read~~ → The book **that / which** I read

## whoever, whatever, whichever
Это «свободные» относительные местоимения со значением «любой, кто / что угодно / любой из». Они вводят придаточное и одновременно выступают его подлежащим или дополнением.
> **Whoever** finishes first wins a prize. — Тот, кто закончит первым, получит приз.
> Take **whichever** seat you like. — Садитесь на любое место, которое понравится.
> **Whatever** you decide, I'll support you. — Что бы ты ни решил, я тебя поддержу.

## Типичные ошибки
- В поясняющем придаточном **that** не используется: ~~The Thames, that flows through London~~ → The Thames, **which** flows through London.
- Запятые обязательны: поясняющее придаточное выделяется с двух сторон.
- **Neither of** — про два объекта, **none of** — про три и больше.
en:
## Which can refer to a whole clause
Normally **which** replaces a noun. But in a non-defining clause (after a comma) it can refer to **the whole previous idea**, roughly 'and this'.
> She passed the exam at the first attempt, **which** surprised everyone.
> The train was cancelled, **which** meant we missed the interview.
- ~~She passed, that surprised everyone.~~ → She passed, **which** surprised everyone.

Common chunks are **which is why** and **which means**: *The shop was closed, which is why we left empty-handed.*

## Quantifier + of whom / of which
To single out part of a group, add after the comma a **quantifier + of + whom (people) / which (things)**: *some of whom, most of which, both of whom, neither of which, all of which, none of whom, several of whom, two of which*. This is typical of written English, reports and descriptions.
> The company employs 500 people, **most of whom** work in the factory.
> She wrote six novels, **two of which** became films.
> He offered me two jobs, **neither of which** I wanted.
- ~~most of who~~ → most of **whom**
- ~~some of them whom~~ → some of **whom** (don't repeat 'them')

## whom in non-defining clauses
In careful writing, non-defining clauses use **whom** for people as objects: *Tom, **whom** I've known for years, has moved to Berlin.* In speech, **who** is fine. After a preposition, only **whom** (see unit 58).

## what meaning 'the thing that'
**What** is not a normal relative pronoun: it does not follow a noun, but contains 'the thing that' itself. A **what**-clause works like a noun.
> **What** surprised me was her calm reaction.
> I did **what** I could.
- ~~Everything what she said~~ → Everything **that** she said
- ~~The book what I read~~ → The book **that / which** I read

## whoever, whatever, whichever
These 'free' relatives mean 'any person who / anything that / any one that'. They introduce a clause and act as its subject or object.
> **Whoever** finishes first wins a prize.
> Take **whichever** seat you like.
> **Whatever** you decide, I'll support you.

## Common mistakes
- **That** is not used in non-defining clauses: ~~The Thames, that flows through London~~ → The Thames, **which** flows through London.
- Commas are needed on both sides of a non-defining clause.
- **Neither of** is for two things; **none of** for three or more.
structure:
## Поясняющие придаточные
| Модель | Пример |
|---|---|
| , **which** + глагол (весь смысл) | He apologised, **which** helped. |
| , **which is why / which means** | It rained, **which is why** we stayed in. |
| , **most / some / all / both / neither / none / several / two** + **of whom** (люди) | ..., **most of whom** were students. |
| , + количество + **of which** (вещи) | ..., **two of which** were broken. |
| , **whom** + подлежащее + глагол | Ann, **whom** we met, ... |

## what и свободные относительные
| Слово | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **what** | то, что | **What** she said was true. |
| **whoever** | любой, кто | **Whoever** calls, take a message. |
| **whatever** | что бы ни | **Whatever** happens, call me. |
| **whichever** | любой из | Choose **whichever** you prefer. |

## Формулы
> основная часть**,** + количество + **of whom / of which** + глагол…
> **What** + подлежащее / глагол + be + …
> **Whoever / Whatever / Whichever** + глагол + …, главная часть

exercises.title: which, whom, what
exercises.example: He was late, ___ annoyed me. → He was late, **which** annoyed me.

items.text: She passed the exam at the first attempt, {{which}} surprised everyone.
The company employs 500 people, most of {{whom}} work in the factory.
He offered me two jobs, neither of {{which}} I wanted.
We interviewed ten candidates, several of {{whom}} had worked abroad.
{{What}} I need most is a good night's sleep.
The concert tickets, all of {{which}} sold out within hours, were resold online at huge prices.
Tom, {{whom|who}} I've known for years, has just moved to Berlin.
The new law, {{which}} comes into force in January, will affect millions of people.

exercises.title: what, that, whoever, whichever
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово: **what, which, that, whoever, whichever, whatever**.

items.text: {{What}} surprised me most was her calm reaction.
She said she would resign, {{which}} nobody expected.
Everything {{that}} I own is in this suitcase.
The train was cancelled, {{which}} means we'll be late.
You can take {{whichever}} seat you like.

items.q: The company cut salaries, ___ led to a strike.
items.why: **Which** ссылается на всё предыдущее предложение; **that** после запятой не используется.

items.q: The report contains 40 recommendations, most of ___ are ignored.
He has three sons, all of ___ live abroad.
___ I like about the city is its energy.
Paris, ___ I visited in May, was crowded.
items.why: Запятые → **which**; **where** не подходит, так как в придаточном есть дополнение (Paris).

items.q: The twins, both of ___ are doctors, grew up in Lyon.
She told me nothing ___ I didn't know already.
В каком предложении which относится ко всей предыдущей мысли?
options: The book, which I bought, was dull.
He passed his driving test, which surprised us.
The car which I bought was old.
items.why: Во 2-м варианте **which** = «и это» (сдача экзамена); в остальных — к существительному.

items.q: There were twenty guests, ___ I didn't know.
___ wants the job should apply by Friday.
items.why: Это подлежащее придаточного (за ним глагол), поэтому **Whoever**.

items.q: She didn't answer, ___ I thought was rude.
items.why: **Which** относится ко всему факту (не ответила) и стоит после запятой.

options: The Thames, that flows through London, is long.
The Thames, which flows through London, is long.
The Thames, flows through London, is long.
items.why: В поясняющем придаточном нужен **which**, выделенный запятыми.

items.q: There are many options, none of ___ is easy.
items.why: **None of which** — модель «количество + of which», без дублирования местоимения.

exercises.title: Соедините с of whom / of which
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно с помощью поясняющего придаточного.

items.prompt: We invited fifty guests. Most of them came.
answers: We invited fifty guests, most of whom came.

items.prompt: She has written six novels. Two of them became films.
answers: She has written six novels, two of which became films.

items.prompt: The manager resigned. This surprised nobody.
answers: The manager resigned, which surprised nobody.

items.prompt: The company hired twenty graduates. Several of them speak Chinese.
answers: The company hired twenty graduates, several of whom speak Chinese.

items.prompt: (Use both of whom) My parents are retired. Both of them live in Spain.
answers: My parents, both of whom live in Spain, are retired.
My parents are retired, both of whom live in Spain.

items.prompt: The exam had ten questions. All of them were difficult.
answers: The exam had ten questions, all of which were difficult.

items.prompt: (Start with What) The thing I need most is a holiday.
answers: What I need most is a holiday.

items.prompt: (Start with What) The thing that annoys me is the noise.
answers: What annoys me is the noise.

items.prompt: (Use whoever) Anyone who finishes first will get a prize.
answers: Whoever finishes first will get a prize.
Whoever finishes first gets a prize.

items.prompt: (Use which) He lied to us. That was the worst part.
answers: He lied to us, which was the worst part.

items.prompt: (Use whatever) It doesn't matter what you decide; I'll support you.
answers: Whatever you decide, I'll support you.
I'll support you whatever you decide.

items.prompt: (Use which) She never apologised. This made things worse.
answers: She never apologised, which made things worse.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя **which, of whom / of which, what** или **whoever**.

items.prompt: Write about your colleagues or classmates. Use most of whom.
items.sample: I work with twelve people, most of whom are younger than me.

items.prompt: Describe a recent decision you made. Use which for the result.
items.sample: I moved to a smaller flat, which saved me a lot of money.

items.prompt: Finish the sentence: What I enjoy most about weekends is...
items.sample: What I enjoy most about weekends is having time to read.

items.prompt: Write about books you own. Use several of which.
items.sample: I own about 200 books, several of which I have never opened.

items.prompt: Give advice using whoever or whatever.
items.sample: Whatever happens, keep calm and call me.

items.prompt: Write about your relatives. Use both of whom or all of whom.
items.sample: I have two uncles, both of whom are musicians.
